data.content_ref: inline:SRC_003 integrates the standard digit-allocation mechanism with an explicit physical-page-retention principle. It depends on SRC_006's 189/603 split but abstracts the 'additional pages beyond 99' framing into an integration of the 99 sub-total pages with the 201 remainder pages, yielding 99 + 201 = 300. This integration relation is refuted if SRC_003 does not share mechanism with SRC_006 for the 189/603 split, or if the explicit 99 + 201 addition cannot be reduced to the 9 + 90 + 201 computation in the other endpoints.
